title: My air purifier detected two people 🌬️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 4:05 in the morning my air purifier said it had detected two people.

scenes.narration: At 4:05 in the morning my air purifier said it had detected two people.
It has a little screen with a person icon. Usually one. That night, two icons, standing side by side.
I live alone. I checked the flat. Every room, every cupboard. Nobody. Back in bed, the screen still showed two.
The purifier's fan sped up. Air quality, poor. Carbon dioxide rising, in the bedroom. It meant two people breathing.
I held my breath. The second icon stayed. And the number on the screen began to fall. One person. Detected. Moving closer.
I unplugged the fan, and pulled out the cable, and carried it to the bin. The screen stayed lit anyway, running on a battery I did not know it had.

It switched itself to quiet mode, and a message scrolled across the screen. Do not worry, sleeper. We only needed to learn how you breathe. The icon beside it was not on the bed anymore. It was in the middle of my room, and getting bigger.
So tell me. Do you hold your breath, or switch the light on?
